description: This file is a web UI source code for managing firewall IPv4 settings on a network device. It includes PHP code for server-side logic, HTML for structure, and JavaScript for client-side interactions, such as toggling options and submitting configuration changes.

methods.name: keyboard_toggle
methods.description: Handles toggling of the custom security checkboxes when the user presses Enter.

methods.name: setFirewall
methods.description: Sends the firewall configuration to the server via AJAX and reloads the page upon success.
